A stunning century powers Chitwan Rhinos into Qualifier 2!
Kamil Mishara stole the show with a sensational unbeaten 120 off just 59 balls as Chitwan Rhinos posted 204/4 against Kathmandu Gorkhas in the Nepal Premier League 2026 Eliminator.
In reply, Kathmandu Gorkhas managed 143/9, handing Chitwan Rhinos a commanding 61-run victory. Rijan Dhakal also starred with the ball, picking up four wickets.
